🔥 The fire settles. Zoltan has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Something displaced a LOT of water, and it wasn't a log — I put it down today." "The water bulges — a ripple with intent." "It loosens, reluctantly, and pours itself back into the water. It will remember this pool."
